title: Maare gaye hussain
body:
ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ran may hai zer e khanjar zehra ka noor e ain
fizza ka hai ye nauha maare gaye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi badan hai saara pyasa lahoo lahoo hai
saydaniyo ka ran may ye bain char soo hai
rahwaar se gira hai ab fatema ka chain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shimr jis galay par khanjar chala raha hai
ye teen din ka pyasa farzande mustafa hai
zehra ka laal hai ye khaliq ki zeb o zain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos fatema ki sarkar lut gayi hai
pyasi sakina kab se awaaz de rahi hai
dukhiya ko tujhse chut kar aayega kaise chain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom bekafan ka laasha zameen par hai
tan khaak par pada hai noke sina pe sar hai
pamaal ho chuka hai ab laasha e hussain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu shikasta bibi kab tak sitam uthaye
koi nahi hai kisko wo haal e gham sunaye
ek laashe bekafan par karti rahi ye bain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bikhre huwe zameen par laashe pade huwe hai
beparda bibiyan hai qaidi khade huwe hai
ahle haram ka ran may barpa hai shor o shain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar par ghashi hai bistar bhi jal chuka hai
abbas aao zainab balwe may berida hai
jalte huwe qayaam se utha ye shor o shain
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar talak mohib ye matam rahega jaari
armaan e sayyeda hai girya ye aah o zaari
emaan farhse gham hai matam hai nasb o laiin
ran may hai zer e khanjar...
author: Mohib Fazli
